mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right workers' comp lawyer in San Diego?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a workers' comp lawyer in San Diego, look for someone with significant experience specifically in California workers' compensation law. Consider their track record of success, client testimonials, and their communication style. Ensure they offer a free consultation to discuss your case without obligation. Proximity to your location, such as San Diego or Imperial Beach, can also be beneficial for in-person meetings. A reputable lawyer will be transparent about their fees and realistic about your case's potential outcomes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a lawyer in San Diego with experience in California workers' comp law, a strong track record, and good communication. Seek free consultations and consider local presence.
